caveats: Both relative signs (`tr_{z_D} +- d_mod(1,1,1) * chi_{(1,1,1)}`) and all 2-crossing stabilizer candidates (`sigma_0^2` interleaved, `sigma_0^2` generator-grouped, `V = sigma_0*sigma_1^{-1}`, `V^{-1} = sigma_1*sigma_0^{-1}`, `L_+ = sigma_0*sigma_1`, `L_- = sigma_1*sigma_0`, plus bare 9-crossing `nuc9` and single-wrap `Delta`) are reported side-by-side without post-hoc selection. Because `chi_{(1,1,1)}(Delta) = -chi_{(3)}(Delta) > 0` on single-wrap `Delta` while `chi_{(1,1,1)} < 0` and `chi_{(3)} < 0` share the same sign on odd-length 9- and 11-crossing nucleon words, `tr_{z_D} + |d_mod(1,1,1)| * chi_{(1,1,1)}` reduces `|tr|` on single-wrap `Delta` (`0.4491 -> 0.3039 MeV`, whereas signed `+d_mod*chi_{(1,1,1)}` gives `0.5943 MeV`) and constructively boosts `|tr|` on all 9- and 11-crossing nucleon words (`0.6519 -> 0.7703 MeV` on `nuc11_interleaved`, `0.6680 -> 0.7865 MeV` on `nuc11_gen_grouped`, `0.6822 -> 0.8007 MeV` on `L_-`).

In `NucleonWeightSpaceTwoTerm.trace_QAdj_connected_diff_borromeanV3`, the 3x3 adjacent-pair trace difference sums across all 3 periods of `V^3` (`denominator 9*q^6`), so `borromeanConnectedDeltaMQED = -(m_e / 3) * trace_QAdj_connected_diff_borromeanV3` equals `-m_e * (q^2 - 1)^4 (4 q^4 + q^2 + 4) / (27 q^6) = -0.331696 keV` identically, matching `two_term_qed_isotope_and_nucleon_compute.py` (`dm_qed_plain`).
